titulo_fr: Comparer deux offres : Observer les formes
titulo_es: Compare two offers: Vocabulary and shapes
intro: Compare performance, price and limits in two product descriptions. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Compare performance, price and limits in two product descriptions. It relates the matter to the request and checks the dates, conditions and actions that the message asks to perform.
Attention point: « Moins cher » compares price; « pourtant » can introduce an advantage that compensates for an inconvenience. In this fragment, «offre» means «offer».

frases.fr: L'offre B coûte 760 euros, mais sa batterie a une autonomie plus courte.
frases.es: La oferta B cuesta 760 euros, pero su batería tiene menos autonomía.
frases.en: The B offer costs 760 euros, but its battery has less autonomy.

frases.fr: La livraison est gratuite pour les deux modèles jusqu'à la fin du mois.
frases.es: La entrega es gratuita para los dos modelos hasta fin de mes.
frases.en: The delivery is free for both models until the end of the month.
